one_liner: Cloudflare has a broad REST API with self-serve API tokens, OAuth client management, and an official MCP server covering the whole API.
auth_notes: API tokens (Bearer) are the preferred documented method. Legacy Global API Key is sent as X-Auth-Email/X-Auth-Key headers. OAuth clients can be created, but coverage of the whole API is not shown, so API token stays primary.
access_notes: Any account can create API tokens from the dashboard. Pages did not directly restate free-plan access, so confidence is medium. Tenant/partner API needs a partner agreement but is not required for the core API.
blocker_notes: No blocker for the core API.

evidence.quote: From the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens/), go to **My Profile** > **API Tokens** for user tokens.
To create an OAuth client, you must have one of these roles for the associated account: Super Administrator, Administrator, or OAuth Client Write.
The preferred authorization scheme for interacting with the Cloudflare API.
For the full OpenAPI specification, refer to the [Email Sending API reference]

After you sign your partner agreement with Cloudflare, Cloudflare will add [certain entitlements](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tenant/structure/) to your account that allow you to provision and manage custom accounts.
